question: Arrange chronologically based on the sequence of years in which the events took place. i. Kallumala Samaram ii. Vazhinadakkal Samaram iii. Villuvandi Samaram iv. Vaikkam Sathyagraha
explanation: This question was asked in Kerala PSC exam 52/2026 (Higher Secondary School Teacher, 29 May 2026). The correct answer is iii, i, iv, ii.
